goal: Removes global static caching from block template generation so cache lifetime is tied to the node
Prevents cached block data from outliving the active chain state in unit tests
Enables unit testing of block template invalidation and retry logic
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Supports tying cache lifetime to the node instead of leaving it in RPC statics (enochaz)
Concept approval noting opportunities to share template caching across subsystems (ismaelsadeeq)
Prefers keeping this change focused rather than expanding cache scope immediately (Sjors)

categories.name: mining
why: P3 because it is internal cleanup that eliminates global state in block template generation
Fixes test-only lifetime bugs and adds compile-time thread safety checks without changing mining behavior
